# Logistics 0.2.1-alpha.10

- The iOS native validation runner recognizes the documented pre-commit WebView stall when the generated Documentation page has an approved target and no live URL. A complete replay still requires sampled Swift worker starvation and proof that the original simulator process exited.
- This source prerelease carries forward the application code and dependency pins from alpha.9. Only a clean first attempt counts toward the release qualification streak.
